title: How to Read a Job Description in 60 Seconds #jobsearch #jobsearchtips  #recruitertips #gethired
description:
When you're looking for a job, here are a few things to look out for to make sure it's the right role (and how to read between the lines so you stand out): 

1. First paragraph 
2. Who you report to 
3. Order of the bullet points
4. Basic qualifications
5. Keywords that tell you what it's like to work there 
6. The keywords that are most important to the role so you can tailor your reusme
